nodes.name: ChatFloatingComposer.tsx
nodes.summary: Default-exported, memoized composer shell that assembles the chat input area, floating cards (plan, ask-question, mode-switch, permission), queued messages, and active-process indicators around the chat history panel.

nodes.name: ActivityRouter.tsx
nodes.summary: Routes normalized session events to the appropriate chat-item renderer (assistant message vs. agent activity), with a memoized comparison layer and an error boundary to isolate render failures per chat item.

nodes.name: isResultEqual
nodes.summary: Shallow-compares two tool-result payloads to decide whether a re-render is needed for a chat activity item.

nodes.name: arePropsEqual
nodes.summary: Custom React.memo comparator for the activity router that checks event identity, status, and result fields to avoid unnecessary re-renders of chat items.

nodes.name: ActivityLoadingFallback
nodes.summary: Lightweight Suspense fallback placeholder shown while a lazily-loaded activity chat-item component is loading.

nodes.name: readLlmUsage
nodes.summary: Extracts LLM token-usage metadata from a session event payload for display or telemetry purposes.

nodes.name: isSyntheticLiveAssistantEvent
nodes.summary: Predicate that detects synthetic, live-streaming assistant events that should be treated differently from persisted ones.

nodes.name: isAssistantMessageLikeEvent
nodes.summary: Predicate that determines whether a session event should be rendered using the assistant-message chat item component.

nodes.name: ActivityErrorBoundary
nodes.summary: React error boundary that isolates render failures within a single chat activity item so one bad event cannot crash the whole chat history list.

nodes.name: AgentTurnContext.tsx
nodes.summary: Defines a React context that exposes the current agent turn's metadata to descendant chat history components, along with a convenience hook to consume it.

nodes.name: useAgentTurnContext
nodes.summary: Hook that reads the current AgentTurnContext value for consumption by nested chat history components.

nodes.name: ChatHistory.types.ts
nodes.summary: Shared TypeScript type definitions for chat history navigation state (follow-agent, browser-add-to-conversation, scroll navigation) and the top-level ChatHistoryProps interface.

nodes.name: GroupChatContext.tsx
nodes.summary: React context provider exposing group-chat helper functions (human-user detection, recipient/sender resolution) to descendant components in the multi-agent group chat view.

nodes.name: GroupChatProvider
nodes.summary: Provider component that memoizes and supplies group-chat utility functions (coordinator detection, recipient/sender name resolution) via context to the group chat view tree.

nodes.name: useGroupChatContext
nodes.summary: Hook that reads the GroupChatContext value for use by group chat message bubbles and related components.

nodes.name: GroupChatMessageBubble.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders an individual group-chat message bubble with sender avatar, timestamp, @recipient tag, markdown body, and tool-use summary.

nodes.name: avatarColorForName
nodes.summary: Deterministically derives an avatar background color from a sender's display name.

nodes.name: avatarLetterForName
nodes.summary: Derives the initial letter shown inside a group-chat sender's avatar from their display name.

nodes.name: formatSummaryPart
nodes.summary: Formats a single fragment of a group-chat tool-use summary for inline display within a message bubble.

nodes.name: GroupChatMessageBubble
nodes.summary: Main component rendering a group-chat message bubble, combining avatar, sender/recipient labels, markdown message body, and any attached tool-use summary.

nodes.name: groupChatUtils.ts
nodes.summary: Central utility module for the multi-agent group chat feature: classifies and normalizes coordinator/member session events, resolves sender/recipient names, converts events into group-chat entries, builds turn rounds, merges concurrent event streams, and tracks per-message tool-use summaries.
nodes.languageNotes: Largest and most central file in this batch (646 lines, 24 functions, 16 exports); acts as the domain-logic hub for group-chat orchestration between a coordinator and multiple org member agents.

nodes.name: readStringField
nodes.summary: Safely reads a string-typed field off an untyped event payload, returning undefined when absent or non-string.

nodes.name: extractGroupMessageContent
nodes.summary: Extracts the displayable text content of a group-chat event from its various possible payload shapes.

nodes.name: isAgentOrgGroupChatUserMessage
nodes.summary: Predicate that identifies user messages originating from the agent-org group chat feature.

nodes.name: isCoordinatorHumanUserEvent
nodes.summary: Predicate that determines whether a session event represents a human user message directed at the coordinator agent.

nodes.name: isGroupRenderableEvent
nodes.summary: Predicate that decides whether an event should be rendered at all within the group chat view.

nodes.name: isAgentOrgInboxTranscriptEvent
nodes.summary: Predicate identifying inbox-transcript events used to reconstruct group-chat message history from the org inbox.

nodes.name: isTaskRelatedGroupChatEvent
nodes.summary: Predicate that identifies group-chat events related to task assignment or task lifecycle between coordinator and members.

nodes.name: isMemberInternalUserPrompt
nodes.summary: Predicate that detects internally-generated user prompts sent to an org member agent, as opposed to human-authored ones.

nodes.name: resolveGroupSenderName
nodes.summary: Resolves the display name of the sender of a group-chat event, falling back across coordinator, member, and human user cases.

nodes.name: convertToGroupEntry
nodes.summary: Converts a raw session event into a normalized group-chat entry with sender, recipient, content, and timestamp fields.

nodes.name: buildRounds
nodes.summary: Groups a flat list of group-chat entries into conversational rounds for turn-based display.

nodes.name: mergeEntryStreams
nodes.summary: Merges multiple per-agent group-chat entry streams into a single chronologically ordered stream.

nodes.name: compactGroupChatDetailEntries
nodes.summary: Compacts detailed group-chat entries by consolidating consecutive related activity into fewer display entries.

nodes.name: buildGroupChatSessionEvents
nodes.summary: Builds the final ordered list of group-chat session events ready for rendering, combining round-building, stream merging, and compaction.

nodes.name: resolveGroupSenderNameForSession
nodes.summary: Resolves the sender display name for a group-chat event scoped to a specific session id, using the agent roster.

nodes.name: resolveGroupMessageRecipient
nodes.summary: Resolves the intended recipient (coordinator or specific member) of a group-chat message for @recipient display.

nodes.name: attachGroupChatToolUseSummary
nodes.summary: Attaches an accumulated tool-use summary to a group-chat entry for display beneath the message bubble.

nodes.name: resolveGroupChatToolUseSummary
nodes.summary: Resolves the current accumulated tool-use summary state for a given group-chat entry.

nodes.name: resolveGroupChatMessageBubble
nodes.summary: Builds the full display model for a group-chat message bubble, including parsing task-assignment prompts into structured subject/id/description fields.

nodes.name: isCoordinatorSessionEvent
nodes.summary: Predicate that determines whether a session event belongs to the coordinator agent's session.

nodes.name: isGroupChatDetailSummaryEvent
nodes.summary: Predicate that identifies events representing a detail/summary card within the group-chat compaction logic.

nodes.name: emptyGroupChatToolUseSummary
nodes.summary: Constructs an empty initial tool-use summary accumulator for a new group-chat entry.

nodes.name: addGroupChatToolUseSummaryEvent
nodes.summary: Folds a new tool-use related event into an existing group-chat tool-use summary accumulator.

nodes.name: hasGroupChatToolUseSummary
nodes.summary: Predicate that checks whether a group-chat tool-use summary accumulator contains any recorded activity.

nodes.name: parseTaskAssignedPrompt.ts
nodes.summary: Regex-based parser that extracts subject, task id, and description fields from a 'Task assigned by X' prompt string, mirroring the Rust-side render_plain format.
nodes.languageNotes: Parsing logic is deliberately kept in sync with a Rust backend formatter (render_plain), a cross-language format contract worth noting for future changes.

nodes.name: parseTaskAssignedPrompt
nodes.summary: Parses a task-assignment prompt string into structured subject, task id, and description fields for display in a group-chat message bubble.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the GroupChatAgent interface describing a member agent's identity and session metadata within the group chat feature.

nodes.name: useGroupChatFeed.ts
nodes.summary: Builds the list of group-chat agents (coordinator plus members) including their pending/active session ids for the group chat feed.

nodes.name: buildAgentList
nodes.summary: Builds the ordered list of group-chat agents (coordinator and org members) with their session identifiers for feed rendering.

nodes.name: useGroupChatMergedEvents.ts
nodes.summary: Hook that merges live session events from the coordinator and all group chat member agents into a single deduplicated, chronologically-ordered event stream, with inbox-row conversion and reply annotation.

nodes.name: AgentEventsTap
nodes.summary: Small tap component that subscribes to a single agent's session events and forwards them upward without rendering visible UI.

nodes.name: toTimestampMs
nodes.summary: Converts a timestamp-like value to a numeric millisecond epoch for chronological event sorting.

nodes.name: payloadTextPreview
nodes.summary: Produces a short text preview of an event payload for use in dedup identity or logging.

nodes.name: inboxRowToGroupChatUserEvent
nodes.summary: Converts a raw org-inbox row into a synthetic group-chat user session event for merging into the unified event stream.

nodes.name: groupChatEventIdentity
nodes.summary: Computes a stable identity key for a group-chat event, used to deduplicate events arriving from multiple sources.

nodes.name: isGroupChatUserSessionEvent
nodes.summary: Predicate that identifies a merged event as a user-authored session event within the group chat stream.

nodes.name: dedupeGroupChatEvents
nodes.summary: Removes duplicate events from the merged group-chat stream using the computed event identity keys.

nodes.name: annotateRepliesToUser
nodes.summary: Annotates merged group-chat events with reply-to-user markers by correlating assistant responses back to preceding human prompts.

nodes.name: useGroupChatMergedEvents
nodes.summary: Main hook that orchestrates per-agent event taps, inbox-row conversion, deduplication, and reply annotation to produce the unified group-chat event stream consumed by the view.
